story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Mill of the Abandoned Ritual. Overcome the Bear Brown holding the disputed sealed door of the trade route. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The local faction wants the work completed before rivals can claim its outcome. Failure leaves the claim unsettled; success gives the party a result they can bring back and defend.

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

reading.title: SHIP
reading.description: A three-masted ship with a couatl figurehead sails across the open sea. The Ship card indicates a long journey, not necessarily by sea.
reading.meaning: A person who routinely travels long distances, such as a sailor, pilgrim, or nomad.

npc.quirk: Boasts of monster kills; wears a predator fang necklace.
npc.interaction: Looking to join an expedition as a retainer (Daily Wage).

reading.title: BALANCE
reading.description: A set of scales holds day and night in balance. This card deals with many aspects of balance, or with things being out of balance.
reading.meaning: A treasure with value to two competing factions, or with two equal magical powers.

faction.name: Meridia City Watch
faction.asset: Water-gate garrisons and armored patrol galleys
faction.agenda: Enforce the curfew, collect harbor tariffs, and quell riots in the lower canal tenements.

npc.quirk: Laughs heartily; buys the table a round of bitter ale.
npc.interaction: Looking to join an expedition as a retainer (Daily Wage).

reading.title: MAZE
reading.description: Unfortunate souls are trapped in an elaborate and impossible maze of cards. Those who draw the Maze card are lost.
reading.meaning: A person who feels lost in their own life, unsure how to affect change, or a person with a wandering mind who takes their time getting to the point.

faction.name: The Bardic College
faction.asset: Acoustic marble academies and printing ateliers
faction.agenda: Preserve artistic truth, educate skilled orators and duelists, and uncover ducal conspiracies.

npc.quirk: Boasts of monster kills; wears a predator fang necklace.
npc.interaction: Searching a nearby dungeon hex for a family relic.

reading.title: CAVERN
reading.description: A vast cavern is adorned with glowing fungi and striking stone formations. The Cavern card suggests exploration and delving into hidden secrets.
reading.meaning: A geode, jewelry made from gems and precious metals, or a magic item that grants darkvision (such as Goggles of Night).

faction.name: House of Seren
faction.asset: Merchant banking houses and spice fleets
faction.agenda: Monopolize overseas trade routes and fund sympathetic candidates for ducal offices.

npc.quirk: Speaks in hurried hushed tones; avoids direct eye contact.
npc.interaction: Searching a nearby dungeon hex for a family relic.

reading.title: TAVERN
reading.description: An adventuring party eats and laughs in a busy tavern. The Tavern card points to the pleasure of spending time with friends.
reading.meaning: A social creature that travels in packs.

faction.name: House of Seren
faction.asset: Merchant banking houses and spice fleets
faction.agenda: Monopolize overseas trade routes and fund sympathetic candidates for ducal offices.

npc.quirk: Spits over left shoulder; carries dried charms and garlic.
npc.interaction: Guiding an exotic trade cart to the next frontier enclave.

reading.title: OOZE
reading.description: A gelatinous cube with various items suspended inside it creeps through a vaulted sewer. The Ooze card indicates the importance of something that seems lowly or innocuous.
reading.meaning: An Ooze or another creature that seems unimportant, or a trap that is surprisingly simple and straightforward.

faction.name: The Shroud
faction.asset: Masked safehouses, poison dens, and pawn fronts
faction.agenda: Enrich members through blackmail, eliminate political rivals, and undermine ducal authority.

items: Ancient Axe (greataxe) — Dragonbone greataxe with a ruby in pommel (220 gp)

reading.title: TAVERN
reading.description: An adventuring party eats and laughs in a busy tavern. The Tavern card points to the pleasure of spending time with friends.
reading.meaning: A person who ruins the happiness of pleasant company.

entry.description: Mithral suit of elvish chainmail (240 gp)

items: Tigulated Mail (chainmail) — Mithral suit of elvish chainmail (240 gp)

reading.title: CORPSE
reading.description: An adventurer lies dead in a dungeon hallway, pierced by arrows. The Corpse card embodies decay and corruption.
reading.meaning: An Ooze or fungus creature that facilitates the decomposition of corpses.

entry.description: Silvered staff tipped with a ruby held in a claw (220 gp)

items: Rune Staff (staff) — Silvered staff tipped with a ruby held in a claw (220 gp)

reading.title: TREE
reading.description: A tree has broken through a fortress wall and reclaimed part of the keep. This card suggests perseverance in difficult circumstances.
reading.meaning: A place cleared of natural growth.

reading.title: CONSTRUCT
reading.description: A modron wields a wrench in the interior of a vast clockwork machine. This card signifies things made by hand, including Constructs.
reading.meaning: An artisan who delights in handcrafted goods.

reading.title: UNDEAD
reading.description: A lich beckons souls of the dead. This card can point to anything that refuses to die, from old grudges and unresolved issues to Undead creatures.
reading.meaning: A person too quick to forgive and forget, who never holds anyone accountable for their misdeeds.
